baseline.role: Recorded production source baseline; exact deployed byte parity unproven
Draft PR #2; feature extraction and safeguards
Draft PR #1; isolated Guest game prototype
Parent documentation audit; no redesign code

owners.rule: No private player state; one registry for current progress
Deterministic scripts; do not import runtime feature components
Read-only checks unless a separately approved release needs more
Accepted decisions versus generated progress versus dated evidence
No cross-feature imports; consume domain/repository contracts
No React, storage or network I/O
Read-only validation and normalization; no save upload/write-back
Tokens and primitives; no feature imports
Generated inputs and versioned supported mechanics
Reference strategies, not personal or active-run state
Dated evidence, not ongoing completion authority

capabilities.name: Local account import, Dex/detail and Trainer
capabilities.limits: Read-only account analysis; no profile manager or save-write-back

capabilities.name: Presets and derived collection priorities
capabilities.limits: Read-only examples and fixed rankings; no editable personal Builds

capabilities.name: Snapshot/history and local backups
capabilities.limits: Combined v2; real-user isolated restore and stronger validation pending

capabilities.name: Extracted UI and canonical five-tab shell
capabilities.limits: Draft branch work; overhaul not implemented or production released

capabilities.name: Installed offline companion
capabilities.limits: Service-worker scaffolding; cold start/update guarantees not established

capabilities.name: Guest Play and simulated Damage Preview
capabilities.limits: Not companion runtime; no proven full damage ranges

capabilities.limits: UserContent and profile ownership not yet implemented

capabilities.name: Run imports and optional companion module lifecycle
capabilities.limits: Informational screens do not establish working capabilities

releaseGates.name: Isolated restoration of actual user backup
Failed-load preservation and strict nested backup validation
Offline cold start and safe cache updates
Explicit merge and production rollout approval

notes: Cloudflare Workers remains authoritative; historical AppDeploy/Pages proposals are not current configuration.
Implementation verification does not prove merge, deployment or production release.
Private account screenshots, saves and backups are excluded; use sanitized evidence.
Redesign and future feature packets remain pending implementation authorization.

tasks.title: Project registry, generated reports and CI

acceptance.description: Task updates regenerate status, roadmap, next task, README and tracked file inventory.
Invalid completion, dependencies and stale reports fail; isolated fixture proves safe deterministic regeneration.
Accepted guidance is preserved; tracking workflow is read-only and needs no app dependency install.
